value: The Saudi Arabian plate — the Arabian plate is a minor, not a major, plate
reasoning: The seven major plates are the Pacific, North American, South American, Eurasian, African, Indo-Australian and Antarctic plates; the Arabian plate, like the Nazca, Cocos, Philippine and Caroline plates, is classed among the minor plates.

The Challenger Deep at the southern end of the Mariana Trench in the western Pacific reaches nearly 11,000 metres and is the deepest known point of the world ocean, deeper than the Tonga, Philippine and Kermadec trenches.

Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are small, dense, rocky bodies formed close to the Sun where only refractory material could condense, and are therefore called the terrestrial or Earth-like planets, in contrast to the outer gas giants.

Tundra occurs poleward of the tree line along Arctic coasts, which is why Russia, Canada and the United States through Alaska all possess it, whereas Belarus is a landlocked country lying between about 51 and 56 degrees North in the mixed forest belt, far south of any tundra.

value: Cirque — a glacial, not a fluvial, landform
reasoning: A cirque is the armchair-shaped hollow excavated at the head of a valley glacier, whereas gorges, canyons and braided channels are all cut or built by running water.

Gandhara sculptors first worked in blue-grey schist and green phyllite, but from the third century CE stucco, being cheaper and quicker to model, took over completely as the medium for the great monastic complexes of the region.

value: The claim that most Gupta coins were of copper — the Guptas are known above all for their gold coinage
reasoning: The Guptas issued their coinage overwhelmingly in gold, the dinara, with silver introduced by Chandragupta II after the conquest of the Western Kshatrapas; copper issues were comparatively few, so the claim that copper coins were the most numerous is wrong.

The Philosophy of the Bomb was drafted in 1930 by Bhagwati Charan Vohra and approved by Chandrashekhar Azad, as the revolutionaries' reply to Gandhi's article The Cult of the Bomb condemning the Viceroy's train attack.

The Resolution on Fundamental Rights and Economic Policy, which committed the Congress to civil liberties, a living wage and state ownership of key industries, was adopted at the Karachi session of 1931 presided over by Vallabhbhai Patel.

Delhi under Bahadur Shah, Kanpur under Nana Saheb and Awadh including Ayodhya and Faizabad were principal seats of the rebellion, whereas at Agra the British retained control, the European community withdrawing into the fort until the revolt was suppressed.

Ibn Battuta reached Delhi in the reign of Muhammad bin Tughluq, who made him qazi of the capital and later despatched him as his ambassador to the Mongol court of China.

Al-Biruni, a Central Asian scholar who came to India with Mahmud of Ghazni, wrote his account of Indian sciences and society, the Kitab-ul-Hind or Tahqiq-i-Hind, in Arabic, the language of learning in the Islamic world of his day.

Parliamentary freedom of speech under Article 105 is a distinct guarantee and is not cut down by the restrictions attaching to Article 19(1)(a), while the Supreme Court has held that privileges must yield to Articles 20 to 22 and to Article 32; on the other hand freedom from arrest extends only to civil and not criminal process, and the immunity attaches only to what is said in the House or its committees, never to a member's private capacity.

value: Members are appointed or elected on a motion made and adopted, or are nominated by the Speaker or the Chairman
reasoning: Parliamentary committees are constituted in more than one way — some by election through proportional representation on a motion adopted by the House, others by nomination by the Presiding Officer — so no single method describes them all.

The Election Commission recognises parties in three categories only — national parties, State parties and registered unrecognised parties — the term regional party being a journalistic description rather than a status conferred under the Symbols Order.

The Forty-second Amendment of 1976 inserted the words socialist and secular into the description of the Republic and added integrity to the phrase on the unity of the nation; fraternity had stood in the Preamble since its adoption in 1949.
Sir Benegal Narsing Rau served as Constitutional Adviser to the Constituent Assembly and prepared the initial draft of the Constitution which the Drafting Committee under Ambedkar then worked upon.

value: The Supreme Court and the High Courts only
reasoning: Writ jurisdiction is conferred by Article 32 on the Supreme Court and by Article 226 on the High Courts; subordinate courts have no power to issue writs.

Citizenship is dealt with in Part II of the Constitution, Articles 5 to 11, the last of which empowers Parliament to regulate the acquisition and termination of citizenship, under which power the Citizenship Act and its amendments have been enacted.
A rare yellow flapshell turtle, its colouring caused by a pigment deficiency, was found in Balasore district of Odisha in July 2020 and handed over to the forest department.

ASEEM is the portal launched by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in 2020 to map skilled workers against employers' demand, its name standing for Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employee Employer Mapping.

The Stay in India and Study in India initiative, aimed at retaining Indian students at home and drawing foreign students to Indian institutions, is run by the Ministry of Education, which is responsible for higher education policy.

Lonar Lake occupies a crater blasted out of the Deccan basalt by a meteorite impact, and the shock-altered minerals of its rocks closely resemble those in lunar samples, which is why it is studied as a terrestrial analogue of the Moon.
Pragyan, the rover carried by the Vikram lander of Chandrayaan-2, was a six-wheeled solar-powered vehicle designed to travel about 500 metres on the lunar surface.
Kinetic energy is related to momentum by the expression p squared divided by twice the mass, so at constant mass doubling the momentum multiplies the kinetic energy by four.
Newton's law of gravitation makes the force vary inversely as the square of the separation, so doubling the distance reduces the force by a factor of four.

value: The claim that neutrons revolve around the nucleus — it is the electrons that do so
reasoning: Neutrons are uncharged particles of almost the same mass as the proton and are bound inside the nucleus itself; it is the electrons that occupy orbitals around the nucleus.

value: The claim that ultraviolet light is a longitudinal wave — it is transverse
reasoning: Ultraviolet radiation is part of the electromagnetic spectrum, with electric and magnetic fields oscillating at right angles to the direction of travel, so it is a transverse wave that needs no medium and has a shorter wavelength than visible light.

reasoning: The absolute refractive index of a medium is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in air or vacuum to its speed in that medium, a quantity always greater than one because light slows on entering a denser medium.
